ProfileSettings.title: Profile
ProfileSettings.description: The AI secretary uses these settings to decide where you travel from, what to suggest, and which identity checks you can satisfy.
ProfileSettings.newProfileNotice: Nothing is saved yet. Choose a home city and save to get started.

hints.email: Taken from the account you signed in with. It cannot be changed here.
hints.address: Shown for reference only. It is not used to work out travel times or identity checks.
hints.verification: The values you enter here are not disclosed. Only the proof that you meet a condition is presented.
hints.birthDate: Used for the age check. Without it, services that require one are left out of suggestions.
hints.residencePref: Used for the residence check, such as discounts limited to local residents.
hints.home: The options come from the transport services that are currently registered.
hints.genres: Up to {max}. Matched against the genre of each restaurant and leisure service.
hints.budgetJpyc: Used as a hard limit when the secretary filters options.
hints.priority: Decides how options are weighted when the secretary picks one.
hints.wallet: The address the secretary pays from. Service providers have their own addresses, which are the ones that receive money.
hints.walletAddress: 8 to 200 characters. The format depends on the network, so it is not checked here.

readiness.title: What these settings unlock
readiness.description: Services that require an identity check are only suggested when the matching detail is filled in.

note.age: Enter your date of birth to include services with an age limit.
note.residence: Enter your prefecture to include resident-only rates.

errors.conflict: This profile was changed somewhere else. Reload and try again.
errors.notFound: This profile no longer exists. Reload the page.
errors.failed: The profile could not be saved.

field.birthDate: Enter a valid date that is not in the future.
field.residencePref: Choose one of the listed options.
field.homeSpot: Choose one of the listed options.
field.budgetJpyc: Enter a whole number of 0 or more.
field.priority: Choose one of the listed options.
field.walletAddress: Enter 8 to 200 characters, or leave it empty.
